title: Cannot pair AAPS and AC Insight
body:
Hi!

I'm just started my AAPS experience and cannot connect/pair AAPS with my AC Insight pump. I see it on the list of Bluetooth devices in the app on my phone but cannot select it. The app just does not respond. I already removed my meter from the connected devices on my pump.

I'm using:
- Google Pixel 6a
- AccuChek Insight
- Dexcom G6 with BYOD (not very important because I cannot finish the setup wizard)
- app-full-release.apk built from the master branch

![Screenshot (16 Apr 2023 21:38:50)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/68027674/232338378-14326d96-1901-4294-aa5b-32623f3b6838.png)

What is the problem?

Thanks, Primoz.

comments.body: After 3 days of trying it finally works...
